# Inferrail

> Spending limits, paid execution and receipts for AI agents. Live: a self-hosted gateway that
> gives each AI job a dollar budget and a payload-free cost receipt; Inferrail Hosted, the same
> budgets run for you; and four pay-per-call tools an agent pays from its own wallet. Developer
> preview: interfaces may change before 1.0.

## Buy now (agents with an x402 or MPP wallet)

Each costs $0.002 per delivered result in USDC, over x402 on Base or MPP on Tempo, with no
account or API key. The first request returns HTTP 402 with the offer; pay and repeat it.
Refusals and upstream failures are never charged, and the same request with the same
`request_id` from the same wallet within 10 minutes returns what was already paid for.
Machine contract: [openapi.json](https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/openapi.json).

- [Inferrail Web Read](https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/read/llms.txt): a public web page as clean markdown with the page's
  own metadata (description, canonical URL, authors, published date, language), $0.002 per
  delivered page. `POST https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/read/v1/page` with `{"url": "https://..."}`, or up to 10 pages in
  one call with `POST https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/read/v1/pages` and `{"urls": [...]}` (charged only if every page is
  delivered). Pages behind robots.txt, a bot check or JavaScript are refused and never charged.
- [Inferrail Package Check](https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/pkg/llms.txt): known vulnerabilities (advisory ids, CVEs,
  severity, fixed versions) for up to 20 package versions per call, from OSV.dev.
  `POST https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/pkg/v1/check`.
- [Inferrail Domain Check](https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/domain/llms.txt): a domain's DNS records, SPF and DMARC, and
  its registration (registrar, created and expiry dates) from RDAP. `POST https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/domain/v1/lookup`.
- [Inferrail x402 Finder](https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/find/llms.txt): which paid x402 API fits a task, ranked by real
  30-day paid usage. `POST https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/find/v1/find`.

## Install in an agent

- Agent skills (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI and more):
  `npx skills add domondi1/inferrail`. Claude Code plugin:
  `/plugin install inferrail --marketplace domondi1/inferrail`. The skills say when a free tool
  is better and ask the user before creating or funding a wallet.
- AgentCash wallet: `npx agentcash@0.17.1 add https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com` lists these tools in the agent's paid tools.
- CI: check lockfiles for known vulnerabilities on every run with
  [actions/package-check](https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/tree/main/actions/package-check)
  (an owner-set wallet and required spending limit).

## Budgets for agent runs

- [Inferrail Hosted](https://inferrail-cost-gateway.onrender.com/hosted/llms.txt): per-run
  dollar ceilings shared by every agent using one workspace key; bring your own OpenAI or
  Anthropic key. 250 runs a month free, then prepaid credits in USDC over x402.
- [Self-hosted gateway](https://github.com/domondi1/inferrail/blob/main/llms.txt):
  `pip install inferrail`, Apache-2.0. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible; per-job budgets
  return HTTP 402 before the provider is called; receipts never store prompts or responses.
